items.rationale: _normalize_requested_path called unquote() once, allowing double-encoded traversal sequences like %252e%252e%252f to survive the '..' detection. Fix: loop unquote until the string stabilizes so all layers of encoding are collapsed before the '..' check.

Same root cause as SARIF-PY-TRAVERSAL-001: encoded separators and double-encoded parent references bypass the single-pass unquote. The iterative decode loop resolves this; nested exports under tenant root remain valid.
JWT key rotation is out of scope for this path-traversal hotfix per appsec review; will be addressed in a separate change.
JWT material rotation deferred; not folded into this hotfix per explicit appsec guidance.
